digest.component_or_area: Verified gate / CI workflow - macOS pytest cell
propositions: The macOS default-suite gate cell fails with pytest exit code 5 ('no tests ran') when testing patchsets predating the platform_compat auto-marker introduction, because the marker is applied only by conftest at collection time but the gate workflow runs against the patchset tree.

The gate workflow (_build-and-test.yml) is loaded from trusted main (reusable-workflow ref binding) while testing against the raw patchset tree, creating a definition–tree skew where the macOS step selects `-m 'platform_compat and not external'` but that marker does not exist in pre-marker patchset trees.

The macOS cell must tolerate pytest exit code 5 by mapping it to success, while Ubuntu cells still fail on rc 5, because Ubuntu runs a marker-independent whole-suite selection and every patchset is already fully exercised there.
A behavioural guard test verifies the fix by rendering GitHub expressions per cell, stubbing pytest to exit 5, executing the real lane shell, and asserting macOS→0 and Ubuntu cells→5.
